findings.evidence: Lines 462–466 use only hf.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport and HasCompactSupport.intro; all statement types come from Mathlib.

findings.evidence: normalLift exposes only apply, I_smul, and neg at lines 135–148; sliceDefectDensity_zero/add/smul at lines 327–344 operate on τ, not v. No direction-linearity lemmas are present.
findings.fix: Expose zero, addition, and real scalar-action lemmas for normalLift, and zero, addition, and conjugate complex scalar-action lemmas in v for sliceDefectDensity; annotate the normal-form lemmas appropriately.

summary: The interface hides reusable integrability infrastructure and lacks characteristic linearity lemmas for the new direction-dependent definitions.
